name: Raleigh and the Undercity
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, this ring was my wife's. Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times. I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me. But desire does still burn in my dead heart, adventurer.

Desire for revenge.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 14 to 20, 4,840 XP in all.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
quests.objectiveText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Engraved Ring
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

quests.name: A Husband's Revenge
quests.objectiveText: Kill Valdred Moray. Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
